title: Second meeting: implants, not ganglion
summary: Bryce Zable tells of Second meeting: implants, not ganglion, about 1996 at Dark Skies offices, Los Angeles, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We did. And he he they said implants >> and it was it was more technological uh some kind of implants.

plain: Bryce Zable, a television writer, says that in 1996, at the offices of Dark Skies, a TV series about aliens he worked on, he had a second meeting with visitors he refers to as JC and the captain. He says they told him the show should be about implants, some kind of technological devices, rather than the idea the show had been using. If true, it would mean insiders were quietly steering how Hollywood portrayed aliens.
